title: Law requiring city fertility treatment information campaign
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to run a public education campaign on fertility treatment, including in vitro fertilization and fertility preservation, and on insurance and Medicaid coverage requirements under New York law. The campaign would use in-person, TV, internet, radio, print and transit outreach in the city's designated languages and distribute materials to public hospitals and clinics. The law would take effect one year after enactment.
